build_noise_fn: build a noise function from Sum-of-Gamma, Gumbel, None, or a custom callable for perturbation sampling
sample_sum_of_gamma: sample from a Sum-of-Gamma distribution decomposing Gumbel into k sub-parts with configurable approximation
noise_for_pytree: generate noise samples for each leaf of a JAX PyTree using a noise function and PRNG key
implicit_mle: create a differentiable sampling function via Implicit Maximum-Likelihood Estimation with custom VJP
test_noise_for_pytree: test noise_for_pytree generates zero noise for non-inexact array leaves in a PyTree
